The end of summer is fast approaching and it’s time to start sending the kids back to school, not to mention you’ve got a business to run! There’s no time to pick up the paper or scour the internet to find school and office supply deals for your business and your family. Luckily, we’ve got some great partnerships to help you and your family get exactly what you need at great prices.

Office Depot – Charlie Company Media clients get access to exclusive daily discounts from Office Depot as part of our Member Benefits Program (learn more here). Whether you’ve got grade school students, a couple college kids, or could use a discount on post-its, Office Depot has everything you need and more to ensure everyone is equipped for their first days back in class and on the job. Not a Charlie Company Media client? No problem, right now Office Depot is offering 30% off a purchase of $30 or more until August 5.

UPS – Have shipping needs? Whether it’s for business or sending your college student care packages, you can get access to shipping discounts through our partnership with UPS. Discounts range from 12-20% on various shipping methods. Learn more here.

Hertz – We’re still a few weeks away from the start of classes and everyone could use a vacation, but you don’t want to pay ridiculous prices on a rental. Our partnership with Hertz allows our clients to get up to 20% off on car rentals and excellent weekend deals. Travel frequently and need reliable rentals all year around? If you’re a Charlie Company Media client, your deals with Hertz never end. Learn more here.

Hyundai – You want to get your soon-to-be college grad or high school grad a new and safe car to get them where they need to go, but as a small business owner you’re not looking to break the bank. For Charlie Company Media clients there’s an option available to you through our partnership with Hyundai. Through the Hyundai Circle A Buying Program, you’ll get access to quality cars at a discounted price. Shopping for a new vehicle just got easier, visit Member Benefits Hyundai to find out more.

Now that you’ve gotten all the deals you need for your students, we can help you focus on your business needs. Charlie Company Media has partners to help you grow and manage your business all year round:

– Lendio, an expert in small business lending to help you get the capital you need for your small business

– Gusto, to ensure your payroll needs are simple and easily managed

– Bookly, an expert in small business bookkeeping services so you know your books are always in order

– Worldpay, a cost-effective merchant services provider to help you process credit cards for your business

– Greensky, a contractor financing service that helps your customers get the financing they need for large home projects

The business benefits with Charlie Company Media are endless! Looking to learn more or take advantage of these offers? Visit our Member Benefits page and find out how we can save you and your small business time and money! Questions, or not sure if you qualify for our Member Benefits program? No problem! Reach out to your personal Digital Marketing Specialist for details.
